name: MQuAKE
description: MQuAKE is a benchmark comprising multi-hop questions designed to assess whether edited language models correctly answer questions that require reasoning over updated knowledge. It evaluates the ripple effects of knowledge editing beyond simple fact recall.
reputation: A well-known benchmark in the knowledge-editing literature for testing whether edits generalize to multi-hop reasoning, though it is still relatively specialized.
notes: Focuses on evaluating knowledge editing in LLMs via multi-hop questions; proposes a memory-based approach MeLLo.
